meta.name: autoresearch-agent
meta.description: Autonomous experiment loop that optimizes any file by a measurable metric. Inspired by Karpathy's autoresearch. The agent edits a target file, runs a fixed evaluation, keeps improvements (git commit), discards failures (git reset), and loops indefinitely. Use when: user wants to optimize code speed, reduce bundle/image size, improve test pass rate, optimize prompts, improve content quality (headlines, copy, CTR), or run any measurable improvement loop. Requires: a target file, an evaluation command that outputs a metric, and a git repo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动循环优化任意文件的可测量指标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果有一个可量化的指标需要反复迭代改进
copy.tagline_en: Automatically optimize any file by a measurable metric in a loop
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a measurable metric to iteratively improve

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动优化你指定的文件。它会反复修改文件、运行评估、保留改进、丢弃失败，直到达到目标或你叫停。
howto.when: 当你要求优化代码速度、减小文件体积、提升测试通过率、改进文案或提示词，并提供一个可衡量的指标时触发。

say.text: 帮我改进 content/titles.md 的标题点击率，用 LLM 评判。
say.note: Claude 会使用 LLM 评估器迭代优化标题。

say.text: 运行 /ar:loop 并设置间隔为 1 小时。
say.note: Claude 会启动自主循环，每小时执行一次实验。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically optimizes a file you specify. It repeatedly edits the file, runs an evaluation, keeps improvements, discards failures, and loops until the goal is met or you stop it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to optimize code speed, reduce file size, improve test pass rate, refine copy or prompts, and provide a measurable metric.

say_en.text: Optimize src/api/search.py for response speed, target 20% lower p50 latency.
say_en.note: Claude starts the experiment loop, editing and evaluating.

say_en.text: Improve click-through rate of titles in content/titles.md using LLM judge.
say_en.note: Claude iterates on titles with an LLM evaluator.
Claude starts the autonomous loop, running experiments hourly.
